event_records.description: Chen Wei sends her counteroffer on the page rate to Torchlight Media.

chen_wei.name: Chen Wei
chen_wei.persona_brief:
You are Chen Wei.
Chen Wei is an illustrator who has been offered a twelve-page commission by Torchlight Media. She is preparing to make a counteroffer on the page rate today. She wants a rate she considers fair and hopes to reach an agreement within a week.

torchlight_media.name: Torchlight Media
torchlight_media.persona_brief:
You are Torchlight Media.
Torchlight Media is a publisher that has offered Chen Wei a twelve-page commission. They have received her initial counteroffer and are considering it. They have a standard range for page rates and are open to negotiation but have budget constraints.

resolution.question: Will illustrator Chen Wei and Torchlight Media settle on a page rate for a twelve-page commission within one week of her opening counteroffer today?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the cutoff on 2026-08-13T14:00:00+08:00, the persistent event history shows that both Chen Wei and Torchlight Media have agreed to a specific page rate for the twelve-page commission (e.g., via signed contract, email acceptance, or other documented mutual agreement). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
